# Milestone reveal: 150+ launches

The milestone-reveal recipe: one big metric over a soft radial glow and particle ring, with its label underneath, for anniversary posts and results slides.

- Type: Milestone reveal
- Skill: `magnifito-promo`
- Engine: `hyperframes`
- Output: 1920x1080, 6 s, silent
- Video: [`../videos/s07-milestone-reveal.mp4`](../videos/s07-milestone-reveal.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Make a 6 second 16:9 milestone card for Magnifito, a Bulgarian digital marketing agency, using the milestone-reveal style. The figure is "150+ websites and campaigns launched"; it is illustrative, so put it in claims.json and say so in a footnote on screen. Put our logo (assets/magnifito-logo.svg) in the corner. Brand: warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #d8c6b4, #f0eadf), dark ink #2b1c17, a touch of green #8acf31, Geist from fonts/. English on screen.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- s07-milestone-reveal
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/s07-milestone-reveal/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
mgvideo render . --force
```

The finished file is `runs/*/final_output_*.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
